digest.component_or_area: Jira DC outbound sync: parent field handling
propositions: Clearing a sub-task's parent field fails on Data Center 8.17.1 with HTTP 400, but clearing an Epic Link on a standard issue succeeds; the outbound clear test must be re-homed from sub-task parent to Epic Link clear path.

The Epic Link clear is observable outbound because _resolve_local_parent returns (True, None) for locally-detached tickets regardless of parent type, and fetcher.merge_parent_map falls back to Epic Link via get_parent_map.

The cell's managed-ref gate requires rebar to set the parent through a local edit in a priming pass to establish rebar as manager; creating the issue Jira-side leaves the ref unmanaged and should_propagate_removal does not fire.
Two existing green cells in run 30951453979 prove that {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1, settling the blocking unknown that held this ticket.
The non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification after Epic Link writes, unlike the sub-task branch; a no-op clear would silently succeed without this check.
